_schema.note: Phase 8 Layer 2 sensory label islands. Each label = independent flavor target (IDEAL compound fractions + TDS_PREFER). Labels are zero-coupled — editing one cannot affect another's scores. New labels are append-only (Channel A discovery). v2: IDEALs re-derived after Phase 9 grind ceiling (compounds.py CGA/MEL plateau now depends on dial). v3 (2026-05-21): + ideal_by_roast — roast-specific IDEAL overrides for roasts that cannot reach a label's default ideal.

fields.ideal: compound mass-fractions (AC/SW/PS/CA/CGA/MEL), nominally summing to 1.0; used as bullseye in scoring.flavor_score log-ratio Gaussian
fields.ideal_by_roast: optional {roast: ideal} overrides — a roast that cannot reach the default ideal gets its own bullseye. balanced.light is a ROUGH model-derived profile (no measured anchor); refine when a light-roast balanced recipe is logged.
fields.tds_prefer: target TDS percentage for this label; scoring's TDS Super-Gaussian centers here
fields.dial_prefer: optional — overrides ROAST_TABLE[roast].dial_prefer when scoring this label. Lets each label encode its archetypal grind style (Hedrick 6.0 coarse vs Hoffman 4.3 fine)
fields.bullseye_anchor: name of the calibration recipe this label was seeded from (Layer 1 link); null for hypothetical labels

balanced.description: Hoffman-style 平衡（Heath bar + 檸檬點心）。中等酸、突出甜感、適度醇厚與烘焙感。

acid-forward.description: April Coffee 酸質為主（清爽、多汁）。AC 主導、低 CGA / MEL、TDS 偏低。

sweet-body.description: 2021 世界冠軍甜感醇厚（奶油、牛軋糖、濃稠）。低溫倒置、高 TDS、低 CGA / MEL。

coarse-modern.description: Hedrick / Gagne 粗磨長浸泡（甜+平衡、不澀）。粗磨表面積有限 → CGA/MEL plateau 低；長時間飽和 SW/PS。

tim.description: Tim Wendelboe Nordic 真淺焙風（多汁活潑酸質、茶感 body、極乾淨無焙烤雜味）。源自 14g / 200ml / 98°C / 細濾紙磨 / 60s 浸泡 / 正置插活塞封壓。
